capability_id.description: Required only when action is correct.

statement.description: Required only when action is correct.

ReminderUpdateRequestV2.description: replace requires a complete valid schedule. pause, resume and cancel require empty schedule fields.

MilestoneTransitionRequestV2.description: result is required only for submit and forbidden for every other action. It is encrypted under the stable Milestone identity.

ProjectTestGenerationRequestV2.description: Closed admission request. No caller-supplied result, passed flag, verdict, evidence_id or test_run_id is accepted.

PortfolioExportRequestV2.description: Closed selection request. content_ref, content_hash, object_version, scan_status, scan_result_hash, Evidence versions and completion verdict are forbidden.

ReviewRecoverySnapshotV2.description: Owner-scoped durable continuation state. Null when a submitted task has not yet admitted an evaluator generation; submitted plaintext is never returned.
